mapper.select: select user_id, user_name, nick_name from sys_user where status='0' and del_flag='0' and (user_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or nick_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')) order by user_id limit 50
select user_id, user_name, nick_name from sys_user where user_id=#{id} and status='0' and del_flag='0'
mapper.sql: u.id, u.name, u.phone, u.status, u.service_status, u.matchmaker_id, s.nick_name, case when u.matchmaker_id is null then u.create_by else s.user_name end as owner, e.entitlement_id, e.remaining_times
from sys_paying_user u left join sys_user s on s.user_id=u.matchmaker_id left join dating_entitlement e on e.user_id=u.id and e.status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select where u.id=#{id}
select id from sys_paying_user where id=#{id} and del_flag='0' for update
mapper.update: update sys_paying_user set matchmaker_id=#{staffId} where id=#{userId}
mapper.select: select h.id,h.user_id,p.nick_name as previous_name,n.nick_name as next_name,h.reason,h.create_by,h.create_time from dating_assignment_history h left join sys_user p on p.user_id=h.previous_id left join sys_user n on n.user_id=h.next_id where h.user_id=#{userId} order by h.id desc
mapper.sql: p.pair_id,p.user_low_id,p.user_high_id,l.name as low_name,h.name as high_name,p.progress, case when l.matchmaker_id is null then l.create_by else ls.user_name end as low_owner, case when h.matchmaker_id is null then h.create_by else hs.user_name end as high_owner, p.create_by,p.create_time

from dating_pair p join sys_paying_user l on l.id=p.user_low_id join sys_paying_user h on h.id=p.user_high_id left join sys_user ls on ls.user_id=l.matchmaker_id left join sys_user hs on hs.user_id=h.matchmaker_id
mapper.select: select where p.pair_id=#{id}
select pair_id from dating_pair where pair_id=#{id} for update
select where p.user_low_id=#{low} and p.user_high_id=#{high}
mapper.update: update dating_pair set progress=#{progress} where pair_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: insert into dating_pair_participant(pair_id,user_id,entitlement_id,rule_snapshot,deduct_status) select #{pairId},#{userId},entitlement_id,rule_snapshot,'PENDING' from dating_entitlement where entitlement_id=#{entitlementId} and user_id=#{userId}
mapper.sql: from dating_pair_participant pp join sys_paying_user u on u.id=pp.user_id join dating_entitlement e on e.entitlement_id=pp.entitlement_id
mapper.select: select where pp.pair_id=#{pairId} order by pp.user_id
select user_id from dating_pair_participant where pair_id=#{pairId} and user_id=#{userId} for update
select where pp.pair_id=#{pairId} and pp.user_id=#{userId}
select from dating_recommendation where id=#{id}
select from dating_recommendation where create_by=#{actor} and request_key=#{key}
select from dating_recommendation where pair_id=#{pairId} order by id desc

select i.id,i.recommendation_id,i.user_id,i.intention,i.reason,i.create_by,i.create_time from dating_pair_intention i join dating_recommendation r on r.id=i.recommendation_id where r.pair_id=#{pairId} order by i.id desc
select from dating_service_event where pair_id=#{pairId} order by event_id desc
select from dating_service_event where pair_id=#{pairId} and request_key=#{requestKey}
select from dating_appointment where pair_id=#{pairId} order by appointment_id desc
select from dating_appointment where appointment_id=#{id}

select h.id,h.appointment_id,h.action,h.planned_at,h.place,h.reason,h.create_by,h.create_time from dating_appointment_history h join dating_appointment a on a.appointment_id=h.appointment_id where a.pair_id=#{pairId} order by h.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into dating_deduction_task(event_id,pair_id,user_id,status,attempts,next_attempt_at) select #{eventId},pair_id,user_id,'READY',0,current_timestamp from dating_pair_participant where pair_id=#{pairId}
mapper.select: select from dating_deduction_task where pair_id=#{pairId} order by task_id desc
select from dating_deduction_task where task_id=#{id}
select from dating_deduction_task where task_id=#{id} for update
mapper.sql: select e.entitlement_id,e.user_id,e.order_id,o.status as order_status,e.status,e.remaining_times,e.exhausted_at from dating_entitlement e join dating_order o on o.order_id=e.order_id where e.entitlement_id=#{id}
mapper.select: for update
select from dating_entitlement_ledger where pair_id=#{pairId} and user_id=#{userId} and entry_type='SERVICE_DEDUCT'
select from dating_entitlement_ledger where pair_id=#{pairId} order by ledger_id desc
mapper.update: update dating_entitlement set used_times=used_times+1, status=case when remaining_times=1 then 'EXHAUSTED' else 'ACTIVE' end, exhausted_at=case when remaining_times=1 then current_timestamp else exhausted_at end, remaining_times=remaining_times-1 where entitlement_id=#{id} and status='ACTIVE' and remaining_times>0
update dating_pair_participant set deduct_status=#{status},blocked_reason=#{reason},ledger_id=#{ledgerId} where pair_id=#{pairId} and user_id=#{userId}
update dating_deduction_task set status='READY',attempts=0,last_error=null,next_attempt_at=current_timestamp where task_id=#{id} and (status='ERROR' or (status='DONE' and outcome='BLOCKED'))
